title: Skewered Grilled Potatoes
description: Potato skewers made with red potatoes coated in a rosemary and garlic marinade, grilled for a tasty side perfect for feeding a crowd.
ingredients: wooden skewers, soaked in water for 30 minutes

steps.text: Place potatoes and water in a microwave-safe bowl. Cook potatoes in microwave on high until just tender, about 15 minutes, stirring halfway through. Drain potatoes and allow to steam for a few minutes to dry.
In a large bowl, stir together mayonnaise, wine, rosemary, and garlic powder. Mix in drained potatoes and toss to coat. Marinate, covered, in the refrigerator for 1 hour.
Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil grate.
Remove potatoes from marinade and skewer. Grill, covered, for 6 to 8 minutes, brushing occasionally with marinade, turning halfway through. Remove potatoes from skewers and serve hot.

video.description: In this video, we'll show you how to grill potatoes to perfection. It's quite easy if you follow this method. We start by par cooking potatoes in the microwave and then marinate them in a bit of mayonnaise and seasonings. Finally, we skewer potatoes and grill them until creamy and tender on the inside and crispy on the outside.
